issue.title: Build View Project Page
issue.body: The View Project page is reached by tapping a project row in the Projects tab. It displays all chapters in a selected project, allowing users to see status and tap into the drafting/checking flow for any chapter — regardless of whether it is assigned to them. ## Functional Requirements ### Page Header - Display the project name as the page title. - Display the language name as a subtitle below the page title. - Include a back button (`li:chevron-left`) in the top left that returns the user to the Projects tab (#32). ### Chapter List - Display a flat, scrollable list of all chapters in the project. - Each chapter row displays: a phase status icon on the left end of the row (see Phase Status Icon spec below), book and chapter name, a workflow status badge, and a right-facing arrow `li:chevron-right` indicating drilldown navigation. - Chapters with no recorded workflow stage display a Not Started badge and omit the last activity date. - When Tier 1 content (source audio and source text) has not been downloaded for a chapter, display a muted gray outline chip with a `li:cloud-off` icon and the label "Source not downloaded" alongside the workflow status badge; the chip disappears once Tier 1 content is available. - Tapping a chapter row navigates the user into the drafting/checking flow for that chapter, using the same entry point as tapping a row in My Work (#31). - Provide no filtering or search on this page. ### Error State - If the page fails to load for any reason, display the message: "Unable to load this project." - Display a "Try again" link on the line below the message. Tapping it retries the load. ### Phase Status Icon (Row Left) Each chapter row opens with a circular icon on the left reflecting the chapter's current stage. Active stages use a solid filled circle in the stage's color with the stage icon in white. Not Started rows show no icon. | Stage | Circle Fill | Icon | Icon Color | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Not Started | — | — | — | | Draft | `#FBBF24` | `li:mic` | white | | Peer Check | `#EA580C` | `li:user-check` | white | | Community Check | `#9333EA` | `li:users-round` | white | | Advanced Check | `#1D9BF0` | `li:badge-check` | white | | Complete | `#16A34A` | `li:circle-check` | white | > **Note:** This is the canonical phase icon reference for the app. My Work (#31) surfaces Draft and Peer Check stages only. ### Workflow Status Badge Colors > **Note:** This is the canonical badge color reference for the app. My Work (#31) surfaces Draft and Peer Check stages only — all six stages are visible on this page. Advanced Check covers all checks after Community Check and before Complete; it is not a new workflow status. | Stage | Icon | Light BG | Light Text | Dark BG | Dark Text | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Not Started | — | `#6B7280` | `#FFFFFF` | `#9CA3AF` | `#1A1A1A` | | Draft | `li:mic` | `#FBBF24` | `#1A1A1A` | `#FBBF24` | `#1A1A1A` | | Peer Check | `li:user-check` | `#EA580C` | `#1A1A1A` | `#FB923C` | `#1A1A1A` | | Community Check | `li:users-round` | `#9333EA` | `#FFFFFF` | `#9333EA` | `#FFFFFF` | | Advanced Check | `li:badge-check` | `#1D9BF0` | `#1A1A1A` | `#38BDF8` | `#1A1A1A` | | Complete | `li:circle-check` | `#16A34A` | `#1A1A1A` | `#4ADE80` | `#1A1A1A` | All contrast ratios meet WCAG AA. Not Started and Community Check use white text in light mode. ## Notes - Row-level sync status indicators are out of scope for this screen. Sync status at the row level is handled on the drafting page (DEC-008).
